headline: Saudis probe how defense systems failed to stop deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
summary: Saudi authorities are probing how defence systems failed to stop a deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, as the attacks threaten global oil supplies.
why: Saudi Arabia is a leading oil exporter, so attacks on its infrastructure can affect global crude supply and prices.

source.name: WSVN 7News | Miami News, Weather, Sports | Fort Lauderdale

why_moved: Attacks on Saudi airports threaten global oil supplies, which can lift crude prices on supply-risk concerns.
